thread:
sarah: FYI Lumen Health sent an RFI. They want: HIPAA & PHI handling details, KMS/HSM integration diagrams, a short capability matrix, and three POC pricing options. Need package by EOD Tue.

devon: Can someone paste the specific items they circled? network constraints?

sarah: Key asks: BAA & PHI flow, customer-managed keys, HSM vendor support, audit log retention, SOC/ISO certs, and whether we can provide FIPS endpoints in a VPC peering setup. They attached a 28-page questionnaire.

priya: For POC ops plan I suggest: 1) sandbox hosted (no PHI) to test models and latency, 2) VPC Private deployment with customer KMS + peering to ingest PHI test data, 3) optional on-prem air-gapped stage for final validation. Keep it short in the RFI.

mike: I'll author the capability matrix rows: hosting modes, data residency, KMS/HSM, audit logs, retention windows, certifications, SLA, and sample latency for 2k tokens. One-liners per row.

devon: Pricing draft (very rough):
```
Eval Hosted (starter): $6,000/month — up to 5M prompt tokens, basic support
Dedicated POC (3mo): $30,000 total — reserved capacity + standard SRE ops
Private Deploy (on-prem/VPC): $60,000 setup + $15,000/month — includes connector work
```
Add note: custom SOW and volume discounts apply.

priya: For the security answers: we can say BAA supported, PHI is processed only in Private or Dedicated with encrypted transport, customer keys supported via AWS KMS/GCP KMS/Azure Key Vault, HSM connector available (Thales/CloudHSM) but certs and FIPS validation depend on the vendor and customer test plan.

sarah: Legal will need to sign off on BAA language. @legal can you confirm turnaround and any mandatory clauses?

legal: We can provide a BAA; typical turnaround is 3 business days for standard terms. If they require custom clauses for data residency or export controls, that will take longer. Note: include our standard DPA and subprocessor list in the package.

ops-bot: Uploaded: https://redwood.internal/lumen/rfi/package_v1.zip (uploader: mike) :white_check_mark:

mike: I also added the HSM integration diagram and the per-route latency report to the folder. Link: https://redwood.internal/lumen/hsm-diagram.pdf

priya: Q on audit logs: Lumen asked for immutable logs for 365 days and tamper-evidence. We can offer 30/90/365 day retention options; for Private we can store logs in the customer's bucket with immutability policies. We should state that we provide SHA256 hashes and periodic attestations on request.

sarah: Good. Can someone draft the RFI cover paragraph? Keep tone concise and prescriptive.

mike: Draft snippet to paste into the response doc:
"Redwood Inference supports phased POCs to minimize risk for PHI workloads. We recommend beginning with a hosted evaluation to validate model fit and latency, followed by a Private VPC deployment to connect to customer-managed KMS/HSM and enable PHI ingestion under a signed BAA. We provide configurable audit log retention, support for common HSM vendors, and reserved capacity options for predictable throughput."

priya: @mike add a short table for p50/p95 for 2k tokens at 100 RPS and 10 RPS so they can see variance.

mike: Quick numbers: Hosted p50 ~ 45ms/token, p95 ~ 180ms/token at 10 RPS. Under 100 RPS burst, p95 can see +30% unless dedicated. Dedicated reserve reduces p95 by ~25% under committed commit levels. I'll include a tiny table.

legal: Reminder: include our minimal export control clause and list of subprocessors. Also flag that HSM vendor contracts may require direct procurement by customer for certain certifications.

sarah: Great. I'll assemble the package (matrix, pricing table, HSM diagram, BAA pointer) and drop in the shared folder. Please review by 4pm so I can send to Lumen before EOD Tue.

ops-bot: Package published: https://redwood.internal/lumen/rfi/response_v1.pdf (uploader: sarah) :white_check_mark:

devon: Thanks all. If legal needs anything else ping here.

sarah: Closing loop: high priority, tagging for review. :thumbsup:
